subject: general
question: Who was the first Indian to travel to Space?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakesh Sharma.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rakesh Sharma**, (**born **Jan. **13, 1949, Patiala, Punjab state, India**) is an **Indian military pilot **and **cosmonaut**.
 
• He was **the first Indian citizen **in **space**.
 
• **In 1970 **Sharma **joined the Indian Air Force **as a **pilot**.
 
• **He flew 21 combat missions **in a **MiG-21 **in the **Bangladesh war of 1971.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Ambalal Sarabhai **was an **Indian physicist **and **astronomer **who initiated **space research **and helped **develop nuclear power **in India. He was **honored with Padma Bhushan **in **1966 **and the **Padma Vibhushan in 1972**. 
 
• **Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam **was an **Indian aerospace scientist **and **statesman **who **served as the 11th President **of India from **2002 to 2007**. He was born and raised in **Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu**, and **studied physics **and **aerospace engineering**.
 
• **Sunita Lyn Williams **is an **American astronaut **and **United States Navy officer **who formerly held the records for most spacewalks by a woman and most **spacewalk time for a woman**. **Williams was assigned **to the **International Space Station **as **a member of Expedition 14 and Expedition 15**.
